$comment: HomeKit map for NOIZYSTDZ. Scene/accessory names here are the contract between ENGR and Shortcuts; HomeKit names are yours (rename to match your Home).

standby.why: room lights 40% warm, ON AIR off, monitors on, booth fan on

session.why: key light on performer, booth fan OFF (noise), front door locked, phones DND via Focus

record.why: ON AIR red, hallway light red, HomePods pause, thermostat fan off

playback.why: ON AIR amber, room 60%, HomePods as monitors (AirPlay from GOD)

sleep.why: LINA sleep takes: 5% 2200K, every fan + fridge plug off, door locked, 20:00+ only

wrap.why: everything off except path light; unlock door; Safety recording stops (via hub)

friday.why: demo for Nicholas AC Mumford: lights 70% neutral, Apple TV on, HomePods paired stereo, ON AIR off

triggers.when: Studio Door opens during a session
triggers.effect: hub marks transcript 'door opened'; if recording → ENGR drops a Logic marker
scene standby + 'someone's in the booth' spoken on GOD
transcript marker 'NOISE' so the take is flagged in the dataset builder

triggers.when: Front door unlocked by LINA's code
triggers.effect: say 'LINA is here' · scene session · open hub on the booth iPad
if session date has LINA sleep pieces → scene sleep at 20:00

hubToHome.$comment: What the NOIZYSTDZ hub does with the room (hub → engr home ...). Implemented in noizystdz/engine/hub.py /home/event and on state changes.
